scope: Source-backed partial passenger/LCV history, 36 existing slugs preserved; selected OEM EU/German version configurations, not all versions or complete historic production.
gaps: Partial historical catalogue: extra 1920s/1930s identities were checked in the production-vehicle overview, but exact periods and bodies remain null until individual model sources are checked. W30 / 150 excluded as prototype / racing history; W31/G4 and military specials excluded.
Pre-merger Mercedes and Benz and historical standalone Maybach not automatically reassigned. Later Mercedes-Maybach S/GLS derivatives belong here but no exact technical row was verified this turn.
Old-generation C/E/S, most AMG, G, Sprinter and electric configurations still lack version tables. See the per-generation matrix; 81 rows are selected, not a complete table.

Scalar consumption remains null for configuration intervals. The eight scalar consumption figures are scoped to the exact compact V-Class variants and the 2016 German brochure procedure, without guessing an NEDC/WLTP acronym.
Most engine power standards, version production periods, kerb weights and many body-specific dimensions remain unknown. No boost outputs or gross/dry/kerb mass definitions were guessed.

Photos cover eight inspected generations before parent core-generation backfill. R107 side view and W447 direct-front view are declared angle fallbacks. Other unsearched or unaccepted generations are not claimed to have no suitable Commons image.

Unique slugs, source URLs, chronological bounds, all null fields indexed in needsReview
